name: CAPA Private (PrivateLink) Cluster Provisioning - OpenShift 5.0 RC
description: Provision a ROSA HCP PrivateLink cluster using CAPA with automated network and role configuration on OpenShift 5.0.0-ec.6, candidate channel. The ROSAControlPlane sets endpointAccess: Private, disabling the public API server and public ingress so all access is via AWS PrivateLink (ACM-21174-Private).

playbooks.name: Create CAPA Private Cluster
playbooks.description: Provisions a ROSA HCP PrivateLink cluster (endpointAccess: Private) using CAPA with ROSANetwork and ROSARoleConfig automation on OpenShift 5.0.0-ec.6, candidate channel

documentation.overview: This test suite defaults to the OpenShift 5.0 release candidate (5.0.0-ec.6, candidate channel). It uses the versioned rosa-controlplane-only feature template with private=true, setting endpointAccess: Private and extracting only private subnets from the automated ROSANetwork. ROSANetwork and ROSARoleConfig are created by the provisioning tasks. The same feature path supports an openshift_version override to 4.22; override channel_group as needed for the target release.
prerequisites: MCE 5.0 RC hub cluster with CAPI/CAPA configured

quick_start.description: Using name_prefix automatically sets cluster_name and domain_prefix consistently

customization.openshift_version: OpenShift version to deploy (default: 5.0.0-ec.6, candidate channel)
customization.channel_group: Update channel: stable, fast, or candidate (this suite uses candidate for the 5.0 RC)
customization.private: Enables PrivateLink and private-only subnets using the versioned feature template

expected_results: ROSANetwork resource created with CloudFormation stack
ROSARoleConfig resource created with IAM roles and OIDC
Cluster provisioned with no public API server or public ingress
Cluster reachable only over AWS PrivateLink
